Ninetales

Fire

Kanto · Generation 1

Ninetales is a Fire-type Fox Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 19.9 kg. It evolves from Vulpix. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (100), with a base stat total of 505.
